user.title: Phone connection
user.description: Home Assistant answers SIP calls directly. After setup, call `sip:USER@{host}` (USER is the SIP user below) from a softphone (e.g. Linphone, Zoiper, MicroSIP), a SIP desk phone or an analog telephone adapter.

data_description.sip_port: Port Home Assistant listens on for calls. The built-in VoIP integration also uses 5060 by default; choose another port (e.g. 5070) if it is set up.
data_description.sip_user: User part of the SIP address and the username for authentication.
data_description.sip_password: Optional. When set, phones must authenticate with the user and this password (digest authentication) before calling or registering.

assistant.title: Voice assistant
assistant.description: Optionally connect the OpenAI voice assistant. Create an API key at {url}. Leave the key empty to only use the keypad menu; you can add it later via Reconfigure.

data_description.engine: GPT-Live is a full-duplex voice model that delegates home control to a fast backend model. The Realtime API is a single speech-to-speech model that uses the tools itself.

data_description.sip_password: Leave empty to accept calls without authentication.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to disable the voice assistant.

error.port_in_use: This port is already in use (for example by the VoIP integration or another SIP Assistant).
error.invalid_user: Only letters, digits and . _ ~ + - are allowed.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by OpenAI.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach OpenAI to verify the API key.

abort.already_configured: A SIP Assistant already uses this port.

init.title: SIP Assistant options
init.description: Keypad commands are managed on the integration page with **Add keypad command**.

call.name: Call flow
call.description: What callers hear and how the keypad menu behaves.

data_description.greeting: Spoken first. Templates are supported (variables: caller, caller_name). Leave empty for no greeting.
data_description.announce_menu: Read out all keypad commands. When disabled, a short tone signals that input is expected.
data_description.menu_prompt: Replaces the generated announcement. Templates are supported.
data_description.assistant_code: Pressing this key in the menu connects the caller to the voice assistant. Press * during the conversation to return to the menu.
data_description.pin: Optional 4–12 digit PIN callers must enter (followed by #) before anything else.
data_description.tts_engine: Used for greeting, menu and confirmations. Defaults to the preferred engine. Without TTS, tones are played instead.
data_description.language: Language of announcements and the assistant. Defaults to the Home Assistant language.
data_description.digit_timeout: How long to wait for more digits before a multi-digit code is submitted. # submits immediately.
data_description.max_call_duration: Calls are ended automatically after this time.

assistant.name: Voice assistant
assistant.description: Requires an OpenAI API key (see Reconfigure).

data_description.voice: GPT-Live offers additional voices that can be entered by name.
data_description.prompt: Personality and behaviour of the assistant. Templates are supported (variables: caller, caller_name).
data_description.llm_hass_api: Tools the assistant may use. “Assist” controls the entities exposed to Assist.
data_description.backend_model: Responses model that runs the tools for GPT-Live.

network.name: Network and security
network.description: Restrict who can call and how media is transported.

data_description.allowed_networks: Comma separated networks (CIDR) that may call. Leave empty to allow everyone (not recommended).
data_description.rtp_port_start: UDP ports used for call audio (one per call). Open them in your firewall if needed.
data_description.external_host: Only needed behind NAT or with port forwarding: address placed in SIP and SDP headers.

error.invalid_assistant_code: The assistant key must be 1–8 characters from 0–9 and A–D.
error.assistant_code_in_use: The assistant key is already used by a keypad command.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must consist of 4–12 digits.
error.invalid_networks: At least one allowed network is not a valid address or CIDR network.
error.invalid_rtp_range: The RTP port range must contain at least two ports.
